exposure: maternal diabetes (diet-controlled gestational diabetes, insulin-dependent gestational diabetes, preexisting maternal diabetes)
outcome: fetal thymus size (anteroposterior thymic diameter, intrathoracic mediastinal diameter, thymic-thoracic ratio (TT-ratio), thymus-head ratio (TH-ratio))
cohort: The study included 161 pregnancies with maternal diabetes and 161 uncomplicated pregnancies, matched by gestational age.
finding: Fetal thymus size, as measured by TT-ratio and TH-ratio, was significantly smaller in pregnancies with maternal diabetes compared to uncomplicated pregnancies.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, with groups matched by gestational age.
gest_age: Matched by gestational age between groups.
